<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Opposition leadership:</strong> Congress leader K.C. Venugopal has confirmed Rahul Gandhi will lead the INDIA bloc in the 2029 general elections amid emerging political shifts.</li>
  <li><strong>State political tensions:</strong> The Congress party has demanded the resignation of former CM KCR ahead of the Telangana Assembly session, while Bhupinder Hooda has accused the Haryana BJP government of misleading contractual workers.</li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Public health litigation:</strong> A new PIL filed in the Supreme Court challenges the Centre’s HPV vaccination drive, raising critical national concerns regarding informed consent and safety protocols.</li>
